{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "BRIEF LENGKAP – STATIC EVENT DOCUMENTATION WEBSITE RESTORAN

Buat website statis menggunakan SvelteKit untuk acara restoran bernama “Midnight Tasting Notes 2026”. Ini adalah event-site + documentation page, bukan aplikasi booking. Fokusnya seperti dokumentasi acara kuliner: rapi, gelap, mudah dibaca, dan terasa premium seperti halaman docs modern ala Vercel.

WAJIB:
- Pure static website saja
- Tidak perlu backend
- Tidak perlu database
- Tidak perlu login
- Tidak perlu form yang benar-benar mengirim data
- Tidak pakai API eksternal
- Tidak pakai realtime data
- Tidak pakai payment / reservasi sungguhan
- Semua konten boleh mock/static/sample
- Bisa dirender sebagai static site
- Gunakan SvelteKit
- Style dark mode
- Sederhana tapi polished
- Harus mobile friendly
- Buat interaksi infinite-scroll untuk konten dokumentasi / timeline acara

KONSEP WEBSITE:
Website ini untuk mendokumentasikan sebuah tasting event malam hari di restoran fine casual. Rasanya harus seperti gabungan antara restaurant landing page, event microsite, dan documentation hub. Pengunjung bisa membaca detail acara, menu tasting, catatan chef, alur malam, FAQ, dan press kit. Tidak perlu fitur transaksi.

NAMA EVENT:
Midnight Tasting Notes 2026

TAGLINE:
A dark dining documentation for one quiet night of seasonal plates.

BRAND FEEL:
- Dark premium
- Minimal seperti Vercel docs
- Restaurant editorial
- Elegant tapi tidak terlalu mewah
- Banyak spacing
- Typography jelas
- Card tipis dengan border subtle
- Accent warna amber / warm gold
- Background hitam kebiruan atau charcoal
- Ada glow halus, bukan neon berlebihan

STRUKTUR HALAMAN:

1. TOP NAVIGATION
- Logo text: Midnight Notes
- Menu: Overview, Schedule, Menu, Chef Notes, Venue, FAQ
- CTA kecil: View Event Guide
- Sticky top navigation
- Dark translucent background
- Mobile: menu sederhana, boleh collapse atau horizontal scroll

2. HERO SECTION
Isi:
- Label kecil: Restaurant Event Documentation / June 2026
- H1 besar: Midnight Tasting Notes
- Subheading: A static guide for guests, press, and staff to understand the story behind each course.
- CTA 1: Read the Guide
- CTA 2: Explore Menu
- Hero visual bukan gambar wajib, bisa pakai abstract panel/card layout
- Tambahkan mini stats:
  - 1 Night
  - 7 Courses
  - 42 Seats
  - Static Guide

3. DOCUMENTATION LAYOUT
Setelah hero, buat layout mirip docs:
- Sidebar kiri untuk daftar section
- Main content di tengah
- Right mini table-of-contents atau “On this page”
- Di mobile sidebar bisa berubah jadi pill tabs horizontal

Dokumen sections:
- Introduction
- Event Philosophy
- Guest Journey
- Course Timeline
- Beverage Pairing Notes
- Dietary Notes
- Venue Details
- Press Summary
- FAQ

4. INFINITE SCROLL REQUIREMENT
Harus ada area “Living Event Notes” atau “Documentation Feed” yang menggunakan infinite-scroll style.
Karena ini static site, gunakan array mock data lokal saja.
Saat user scroll ke bawah, tampilkan batch kartu catatan berikutnya dari data statis.
Tidak boleh ambil API.
Contoh item feed:
- Note 01: Arrival scent is rosemary smoke
- Note 02: First pour served at 19:10
- Note 03: Kitchen pass lighting changed to warm amber
- Note 04: Dessert card includes origin note
- Note 05: Staff briefing language
- dst minimal 24 item mock supaya infinite-scroll terasa jalan
Boleh pakai IntersectionObserver client-side, tapi data tetap lokal/static.
Tambahkan indikator kecil “Loading more notes...” saat batch berikutnya muncul, tapi jangan benar-benar fetch network.

5. EVENT OVERVIEW CARDS
Buat card grid:
- Date: 29 June 2026
- Location: The Cellar Room, North Table Restaurant
- Format: 7-course guided tasting
- Dress Code: Quiet evening casual
- Capacity: 42 guests
- Documentation: Static guide only

6. MENU SECTION
Buat daftar 7 course dengan gaya elegan:
Course 01 – Cold Tomato Water, basil oil, smoked salt
Course 02 – Charred Leek Broth, black garlic crumb
Course 03 – Rye Tartlet, mushroom cream, onion ash
Course 04 – Slow Fish, fennel, citrus skin
Course 05 – Lamb Shoulder, burnt honey glaze
Course 06 – Blue Cheese Leaf, pear vinegar
Course 07 – Midnight Chocolate, coffee soil, sea salt

Setiap course punya:
- nomor course
- nama
- deskripsi pendek
- pairing note
- allergy note kecil

7. CHEF NOTES SECTION
Buat bagian seperti documentation callout:
- Why the room stays dark
- Why the menu avoids heavy plating
- Why each course has a written note
- How guests should read the menu
Gunakan blockquote, callout, dan code-like label seperti docs.
Contoh callout:
NOTE: This website is a static documentation preview. No reservation data is collected.

8. SCHEDULE / TIMELINE
Timeline vertikal:
18:30 Doors open
18:45 Welcome drink
19:00 First course
19:40 Broth course
20:20 Main course
21:10 Dessert documentation card
21:30 Closing note
22:00 Room reset

Style timeline dark dengan titik amber.

9. VENUE SECTION
Buat info tempat tanpa map API:
- Nama venue
- Alamat mock
- Ruang: The Cellar Room
- Suasana: low light, 42 seats, open pass
- Akses: walking distance from old market street
Tidak pakai Google Maps embed. Kalau perlu visual, buat card peta abstrak statis pakai CSS.

10. FAQ
FAQ statis, bisa accordion client-side biasa.
Pertanyaan:
- Is this a booking page?
- Can I reserve a seat here?
- Are the menu items final?
- Is dietary information included?
- Is this guide printable?
Jawaban harus menegaskan ini hanya static documentation guide.

11. FOOTER
- Midnight Notes
- Static event documentation for a restaurant tasting night
- Links: Overview, Menu, Notes, Venue
- Tiny text: Built as a static SvelteKit site. No external services required.

VISUAL DETAIL:
- Dark background #050507 atau #09090b
- Text utama off-white
- Secondary text gray
- Accent amber/gold #d6a85c
- Border rgba putih tipis
- Font boleh system font atau pakai CSS saja, jangan wajib external font
- Cards rounded 16px
- Button hover smooth
- Section spacing lega
- Code/documentation feel: small labels, badges, callout boxes
- Reference mood: Vercel style docs/marketing, tapi bertema restoran malam

KOMPONEN YANG DIHARAPKAN:
- Header/Nav
- Hero
- DocsLayout
- SectionCard
- CourseCard
- Timeline
- InfiniteNotesFeed
- FAQAccordion
- Footer

TECH NOTES:
- SvelteKit static front-end
- Semua data disimpan lokal di file component atau data array
- Tidak perlu adapter deployment detail, tapi struktur harus cocok untuk static render
- Jangan bikin endpoint server
- Jangan bikin auth
- Jangan bikin database
- Jangan connect ke layanan apa pun
- Jangan pakai image API
- Kalau butuh gambar, gunakan gradient/placeholder CSS saja

INTERAKSI RINGAN:
- Smooth scroll ke section dari nav
- FAQ accordion
- Infinite scroll untuk notes feed dari data lokal
- Active-ish hover states pada cards
- Mobile responsive

OUTPUT YANG SAYA MAU:
Buat satu website siap jalan secara statis dengan SvelteKit. Prioritaskan tampilan yang rapi dan realistis. Konten boleh mock, tapi jangan terlihat kosong. Saya ingin hasilnya seperti template event documentation restoran premium yang bisa langsung dipreview dan dideploy ke static hosting seperti Vercel tanpa konfigurasi backend.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
